title: Repair a storage configuration (Azure Blob)
description: The reports service fails every storage check although its Blob container exists. Find the misconfiguration, point the service at the right container, and verify a fresh round trip.

objectives.label: Find the storage error in the service logs or configuration
Point the service at the container that holds its reports
Verify a fresh round trip through the service's storage check

hints: Read the api logs: which container does the failing storage check use?
Compare it with the containers listed in the Cloud panel. One letter is missing.
Change the service container in the Cloud panel, then run the storage check again. Creating a container with the wrong name would hide the real mistake.
solution: Cloud panel: set the api container to lab-reports and apply
